lines.text: Hello again. How's the neck been treating you?
Up and down. My husband's just parking, he wanted to come in and hear what you say.
Sorry I'm late, the car park's heaving.
No problem at all, grab that chair.
The headaches have crept back, three or four a week, always starting at the base of my skull.
She's been sleeping on two pillows again, I've told her about it.
Let me have a look at your turning. Look over your left shoulder for me.
Turning left is pretty tight, about half what you get to the right.
It might be that the desk setup has slipped since you went back to the office, but I'd want to see how it responds before I'm sure.
Drop to one pillow, and set your screen so the top edge is level with your eyes.
If you get a headache that's sudden and the worst of your life, or any double vision, call an ambulance.
We'll keep an eye on that.
Same time in two weeks, then.
